'''In the Red''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Uldir Lochett]] and his crew encountered [[Klin-Fa Gi]] there while waiting for their [[No Luck Required|ship]] to be repaired.
